name: Zealot locuste
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE isolated static full-body 2D game character sprite.
Primary request: recreate the Gears Tactics LOCUST ZEALOT shown in the supplied official full-body reference, faithfully preserving its identity, costume and anatomy in one planted guard pose. Reference is the production render from the publisher's Developer Blog: Enemies (Ukkon's Creations). Keep this Tactics version; not a generic Kantus and not a Gears 5 recolor.
Subject: one tall lean monstrous Locust Zealot, pale scaly leathery skin, elongated legs ending in broad bare three-toed clawed feet, ornate pointed pale metallic helmet framing its dark toothy face; dark worn chest and shoulder armor; mechanical chest harness with luminous yellow imulsion reservoirs and dark tubing; glowing amber branching veins across exposed arms; pale angular segmented plate skirt and thigh armor, one Gorgon sidearm as shown in the reference. Preserve exact pattern and proportion cues.
Pose: calm stable neutral combat-ready stance, three-quarter SIDE view facing screen RIGHT, both feet planted, arms in guard and sidearm lowered. Entire subject including helmet, clawed feet and firearm contained in image with 8 percent empty TRANSPARENT margins on every side.
Style: realistic high-detail Gears material texture translated into a polished hand-painted 2D fighting-game cutout, crisp readable silhouette, neutral light, no scene.
Background: true transparent alpha outside the body. No floor, no cast shadow, no smoke, no dust, no glow cloud, no backdrop, no vignette. Retain yellow light ONLY within skin veins and harness; fully opaque body and gear with antialiased silhouette.
Constraints: a single Zealot only, one full-body still pose, no animation, no duplicate, no spritesheet, no text, no logo, no border. Match provided official reference as closely as possible; do not redesign its armor.
reference_scope: Publisher full-body Zealot production render under Ukkon's Creations, visually inspected before generation.

qa.visual_review: One Zealot, intact body, pointed helmet, angular tassets, bare clawed feet, tubes and yellow branching veins. Margins smaller than requested; silhouette and base costume recognizable. Exact topology not certified.
qa.alpha_review: PNG RGBA with genuine alpha. All corners transparent; outside coverage measured. RGB halo in raw preview is not proof of opaque background.
observations: One Zealot, intact body, pointed helmet, angular tassets, bare clawed feet, tubes and yellow branching veins. Margins smaller than requested; silhouette and base costume recognizable. Exact topology not certified.
